recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中央有一顆比周圍細胞大好幾倍的組織球，細胞質被大量大小相近、邊界清楚的透明小空泡填滿，呈泡沫或肥皂泡狀，核小而偏中央、染色較深。這種「泡沫細胞」是 Niemann-Pick 細胞的樣子，但需與其他泡沫組織球鑑別。
features: Very large histiocyte, roughly 5–6 times the diameter of adjacent red cells
Cytoplasm packed with numerous small, sharply defined, fairly uniform clear vacuoles (foamy/soap-bubble appearance)
Small, relatively condensed central nucleus with irregular outline
Faint lilac cytoplasmic strands between vacuoles; no striated 'crumpled tissue paper' texture
Background marrow elements including erythroid precursors and myeloid cells
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a very large histiocyte whose cytoplasm is filled with numerous small, sharply defined, uniform clear vacuoles, imparting a foamy soap-bubble appearance, with a small central nucleus. The cytoplasm lacks the fibrillary crumpled-tissue-paper texture of Gaucher cells. Surrounding hematopoietic cells, including erythroid and myeloid precursors, are present. Findings are consistent with a Niemann-Pick cell (foamy lipid-laden histiocyte); confirmation with sphingomyelinase activity or SMPD1/NPC1/NPC2 genetic testing is required, as sea-blue histiocytes and other foamy macrophages can overlap.

ddx.vs: Gaucher cells have fibrillary, striated 'crumpled tissue paper' cytoplasm without discrete vacuoles and are strongly PAS and tartrate-resistant acid phosphatase positive.
Sea-blue histiocytes contain blue-green ceroid granules on Giemsa, whereas this cell shows clear uniform vacuoles; both may coexist in Niemann-Pick disease.

ddx.dx: Pseudo-Gaucher or foamy cells in high cell-turnover states (CML, thalassemia, myeloma)
ddx.vs: Secondary foamy histiocytes appear in increased cell-turnover conditions and have normal enzyme activity, so clinical and biochemical correlation is needed.

ddx.dx: Fat cell or lipid-laden macrophage in marrow
ddx.vs: Adipocytes show one or few large vacuoles with a peripheral flattened nucleus rather than numerous small uniform vacuoles.
